title: Todd and the Bread with a Hole
synopsis: Todd and Ben look through ring-shaped bread at the bakery on Market Street and consider the practical problems of bread-shaped boots.
continuity_state: Before: Todd lives east in Reed Meadow with Aunt Pat and two yellow boots, one blue-patched. Ben knows the market pigeon bench. Market Street has a bakery. After: Todd and Aunt Pat travel west by the usual bridge, Village Green and Bell Hill to the green bus stop, taking rests; Ben and his grown-up accompany them on the bus. Todd and Ben eat ring-shaped bread at a clean bakery table and go home with their grown-ups. No actual bread shoes or bakery goods are left as permanent props. Todd now knows the bakery and the shop clock across the street.
